decision: Supported source-contract correction: native whole-millisecond duration49 is legitimate for the pinned default non-isolated Chromium profile; do not treat it as below-threshold fabricated data.
scope: Independent primary normative and exact Chromium153.0.8010.12 source assessment, plus read-only inspection of the existing collector/raw report. No browser run, test run, benchmark rerun or repository edit. This assessment approves no unreviewed code implementation or release proof.

normativeChain.specification: W3C Working Draft19 March2026, Long Tasks4.1, current and dated copies byte-identical. Revision metadata65eb2e6aad59f4d342ff3be81777c4b25b9d10d0.
normativeChain.ordering: The internal end-minus-start threshold is checked before endpoint coarsening. Entry start is coarsened; duration is the integer part of coarsened end minus that coarsened start.
normativeChain.consequence: The50ms task-classification boundary does not imply an exposed entry.duration lower bound of50. Spec-wide privacy coarsening can vary, so implementation-specific lower bounds require implementation evidence.

exactImplementationChain.finding: LongTaskFromLongAnimationFrame has stable status in the exact Chromium release; the default path is the animation monitor, not only the legacy PerformanceMonitor.
Default animation monitor compares native task_duration against a50ms TimeDelta before forwarding original start/end timestamps.
The widget forwards those original endpoints to each WindowPerformance ReportLongTask; WindowPerformance passes them to AddLongTaskTiming.

AddLongTaskTiming independently converts start and end through MonotonicTimeToDOMHighResTimeStamp, subtracts the exposed doubles and casts the result to int. Conversion uses the document isolation flag and the same origin subtraction.
Non-isolated resolution is100 microseconds; isolated resolution is5 microseconds. Per-interval deterministic pseudorandom thresholds round each endpoint to its current or next resolution boundary.
The entry constructor takes int duration and passes it unchanged to PerformanceEntry; native reported duration is an integer, not an arbitrary fractional sample.
The legacy fallback also applies its internal50ms subscription threshold before conversion. This confirms compatibility but is not substituted for checking the default path.

supportedMinimum.profile: Pinned Chromium153.0.8010.12 via Playwright1.63.0, ordinary non-isolated benchmark page, standard timing policy, finite benchmark task/window durations.
supportedMinimum.derivation: Each independently clamped endpoint differs from its internal endpoint by less than0.1ms. Thus their difference for a threshold task is greater than49.8ms before tiny ordinary floating-point representation error. Integer truncation may return49, while48 is unsupported by this profile. The shared coarsened origin cancels in the endpoint difference apart from ordinary double rounding.
supportedMinimum.illustrativePossibleWitness: Internal start1000.050ms and end1050.051ms differ by50.001ms. Allowed endpoint decisions may expose1000.1ms and1050.0ms. Their49.9ms difference truncates to49. This is a mathematical source-semantics example, not a fabricated benchmark record or claim about the hidden endpoint values of the actual observed task.
supportedMinimum.limits: This is not a universal lower bound for all browsers, privacy modes, alternate timing policies, arbitrary experimental flags or exceptionally large timestamp magnitudes. A different runtime/profile requires separate contract review. It does not establish the exact pre-coarsening duration of the observed49ms record.

actualExistingEvidence.collectorObservation: The observer copies entry.startTime and entry.duration directly. It neither derives duration from timestamps nor rounds/clamps/invents49. Metrics then use the preserved duration unchanged.
actualExistingEvidence.statusBoundary: The old report records numerical passed/zero regressions but existing raw verifier rejects duration49. This assessment does not edit or relabel any report, historical error, failed verifier result or source identity.

correctionClassification.supportedNarrowChange: Validate Number.isInteger(task.duration) && task.duration >=49 for native task representation in this pinned profile, retaining all existing timing-window/order checks.
correctionClassification.whyNotRegressionToleranceRelaxation: This adjusts admissible native API representation. It does not change the comparator acceptance bound, max statistic, relative0.30 allowance, absolute50ms allowance, idle/pause/memory/work gates, task-count or blocking-time computations. Requiring integers also rejects fractional fabricated durations previously accepted.
mustRemainUnchanged: All original raw49 bytes and computed metrics. No rounding49 up to50 and no dropping that entry.

correctionClassification.requiredProcess: Author only a minimal separately frozen correction; obtain fresh independent source review, run unit/comparator negatives, and rerun actual final-tag historical/full-anchor and injected-browser proofs.
